item.text:
Implemented in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx). The async Server Component calls `await connection()` from `next/server` before creating the timestamp. This is Next.js’s recommended approach for skipping static prerendering without accessing cookies or headers.

The page displays the current server time in ISO format. Updated the page metadata to match.

Verified the production build marks `/` as dynamic and two consecutive requests return different timestamps.
